conditions.subject: Immutable original attempt set and bounded review overlay

conditions.subject: Actual independent causal review and execution-time admission
conditions.required: A syntactic VERIFIED/hash/reviewer claim is not authentication or causality. Require actual hash-bound closed review and independent adoption; admission must predate original execution, never only later rescore time.

conditions.required: Charge each started learn once, suppress suffix after base stop/failure/leak, preserve partial and unknown data, and distinguish successful base state from a claim that the whole incremental workflow succeeded.
